verdict.rationale: An agent app could plausibly emit run or task events to registered HTTP endpoints, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented outbound webhook capability. The related features in the pack are Siri/Shortcuts triggers for saved tasks, the Dynamic Island status display, and manual trace export. None of these are registrable HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
